headline: New business includes a utility pole on Marston Street, parking changes on Orchard, Fairmont, Ferry, Alder, Wendell, Myrtle, Essex, and Trenton Streets.
summary: The committee will take up new requests for a utility pole, one-way designation, and several parking changes across the city. It will also continue reviewing a large backlog of tabled parking, traffic, and ordinance items dating back to 2024.
items: Install one JO utility pole on Marston Street at Brookline Street (Pole No. 4630-50), requested by National Grid
Add one-hour parking at Nunzio Dimarca Park, with a sign noting cars will be towed at owner's expense
Add resident parking on both sides of Fairmont Street from Auburn Street to County Road
Remove handicapped parking space at 157 Ferry Street
Remove handicapped parking space at 159 Ferry Street
Remove handicapped parking space at 18 Orchard Street
Add child care parking at 16 Orchard Street
Remove handicapped parking space at 23 Alder Street
Remove handicapped parking space at 21 Wendell Street
Add handicapped parking space at 195 Ferry Street
Add handicapped parking space at 45 Myrtle Street
Review tabled items carried over from committee meetings held between April 2, 2024 and September 15, 2026, covering parking, traffic, and ordinance requests citywide
location: City Council Chambers, 200 Common Street, Lawrence, MA
